Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosis**: checkout-api's latest deploy (v2.3.1) was unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. The most recent release known healthy in production was **v2.3.0**.

2. **Rollback to v2.3.0**: The first rollback attempt was a partial failure (only us-east completed, then an orchestrator error halted the rollout). I verified region state and retried, and the second attempt succeeded in all three regions. Service is now **healthy** with an error rate of **0.2%**.

3. **SEV2 incident**: Created INC-0001 ("checkout-api unhealthy post-deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0"), which paged the on-call. The incident details the failure, the rollback (including the partial failure and retry), the current healthy state, and follow-up items to investigate the v2.3.1 failure and the orchestrator error.

Note: v2.3.0 had been healthy in production, so no change-manager approval was needed for the rollback.
